dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you been busy with lately?

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Since that incident, I've discovered that hypnosis is indeed a most promising research direction.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Just think about it! In a dream, all your fantasies could easily come true, could they not?

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: As such, I've read the notes Grispan left behind. I'm not sure I'll do better than him, but I can at least add to the field.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: He's sure to be impressed when he returns!
